claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is primarily taking place in loanDepot park in Miami, Florida.
LoanDepot park hosts pool play, quarterfinals, semifinals, and the final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan is an additional host site for the March 2026 World Baseball Classic tournament.
Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico is an additional host site for the March 2026 World Baseball Classic tournament.
Daikin Park in Houston, Texas is an additional host site for the March 2026 World Baseball Classic tournament.
Final rounds of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are at LoanDepot Park in Miami, Florida.
The championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, in Miami.
Host cities for the 2026 World Baseball Classic are Miami, Houston, Tokyo, and San Juan.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic features 20 teams.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic takes place from March 5 to March 17.
